title: TaskGraph artifact
description: Produced by the Architect in PLAN. A directed acyclic graph of Tasks. Every Task MUST carry a non-empty verification_command: work that cannot be checked never enters the queue (FR-024, ADR-0014). Acyclicity and the Project Task ceiling are enforced by GUARD_PLAN_VALID, which this schema cannot express.

local_id.description: Unique within this graph. Persisted Tasks receive UUIDs; the local id exists so the model can express dependencies without inventing UUIDs.

verification_command.description: The oracle. Executed verbatim in a Sandbox with no network; its exit code is the sole determinant of success. Immutable after plan acceptance (FR-034).

verification_source.description: Which path produced the command. Architect-generated commands are accepted only when the Project enables them; see OQ-07.

pre_change_must_fail.description: Required true for Tasks of kind 'test': the command must fail against the pre-change tree and pass after, otherwise a trivially-passing test would verify itself.

target_paths.description: A retrieval hint, not a constraint. The patch policy validator, not this list, decides what may be written.
